code.python:
def knapsack_bnb(W, items, n):
    queue = [(-1, 0, 0, 0)]  # (level, profit, weight, bound)
    max_profit = 0
    def calc_bound(level, profit, weight):
        if weight >= W: return 0
        b, tw, j = profit, weight, level + 1
        while j < n and tw + items[j][0] <= W:
            tw += items[j][0]; b += items[j][1]; j += 1
        if j < n: b += (W - tw) * items[j][2]
        return b
    queue[0] = (-1, 0, 0, calc_bound(-1, 0, 0))
    from collections import deque
    q = deque(queue)
    while q:
        level, profit, weight, bound = q.popleft()
        if level == n - 1: continue
        nl = level + 1
        nw, np = weight + items[nl][0], profit + items[nl][1]
        if nw <= W and np > max_profit: max_profit = np
        b = calc_bound(nl, np, nw)
        if b > max_profit: q.append((nl, np, nw, b))
        b = calc_bound(nl, profit, weight)
        if b > max_profit: q.append((nl, profit, weight, b))
    return max_profit

solution.timeComplexity: O(2^n) worst case, significantly less with pruning

code.python:
def job_assignment_bnb(cost, n):
    import heapq
    def calc_bound(level, assigned, cur_cost):
        bound = cur_cost
        for i in range(level, n):
            mn = min(cost[i][j] for j in range(n) if not assigned[j])
            bound += mn
        return bound
    pq = []
    assigned = [False]*n
    heapq.heappush(pq, (calc_bound(0, assigned, 0), 0, 0, tuple(assigned)))
    best = float('inf')
    while pq:
        bound, cost_so_far, level, assigned = heapq.heappop(pq)
        if bound >= best: continue
        assigned = list(assigned)
        if level == n: best = min(best, cost_so_far); continue
        for j in range(n):
            if not assigned[j]:
                assigned[j] = True
                c = cost_so_far + cost[level][j]
                b = calc_bound(level+1, assigned, c)
                if b < best: heapq.heappush(pq, (b, c, level+1, tuple(assigned)))
                assigned[j] = False
    return best

solution.timeComplexity: O(n! * n) worst case, much less with pruning

description.en: Given a set of n positive integers and a target sum S, find a subset whose elements sum up to exactly S. Use the Branch and Bound approach to efficiently prune the search space. Print the subset if found, otherwise print -1.
description.hi: n positive integers ka set diya hai aur ek target sum S hai. Ek aisa subset dhundho jiske elements ka sum exactly S ho. Search space ko efficiently prune karne ke liye Branch and Bound approach use karo. Agar subset mile toh print karo, nahi toh -1 print karo.

explanation.en: Subset {5, 10} has sum = 15. B&B prunes branches where: (1) current sum exceeds S, or (2) current sum + sum of remaining elements < S (impossible to reach target).
explanation.hi: Subset {5, 10} ka sum = 15 hai. B&B un branches ko prune karta hai jahan: (1) current sum S se zyada ho jaye, ya (2) current sum + baaki elements ka sum < S (target tak pahunchna impossible).

hints.en: Sort the array first. If current sum + remaining sum < target, prune (can't reach target). If current sum > target, prune (exceeded target).
hints.hi: Pehle array sort karo. Agar current sum + remaining sum < target, prune karo (target tak nahi pahunch sakte). Agar current sum > target, prune karo (target exceed ho gaya).

hints.en: Use two bounds: current sum should not exceed S, and current sum + sum of remaining elements should be >= S
hints.hi: Do bounds use karo: current sum S se zyada nahi hona chahiye, aur current sum + baaki elements ka sum >= S hona chahiye
